card.name: The first "as" in "as soon as"
card.fires_on: The word "as" that opens "as soon as possible" or "as soon as they are able", right after a verb and its object. It appears in instructions on missed doses, restarting or switching treatment.

modes.label: Missed or delayed dose
modes.description: "as" follows administer/restart/reinsert plus the dose or item, before "soon as possible".
modes.example: If a dose is missed, administer the dose<< as>> soon as possible. Thereafter, resume

modes.label: Switch or catch-up
modes.description: "as" follows a switch or vaccination instruction, before "soon as they are able" or "as possible".
modes.example: patients should be switched to oral PREVYMIS<< as>> soon as they are able to take oral

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "as much as possible" or "the more the better", mostly in Chinese and Vietnamese, which fits the "as ... as" frame.
